summary.answer: Takes owner,feed,type,instance,axis,direction,insertionSide,itemCount,controller. Creates controller model feeds.<type>.<instance>, stores type as its value and attaches it to feed; then writes axis and direction. BEGINNING selects AddFeedItemToBeginning and FreeFeedItemFromEnd pointers, END selects opposite pointers; any other side raises the exact source error after these preceding mutations. Writes instance/type-table reference, registers selected free pointer for free_feed_item, calls InitFeedItems(feed,count,controller), creates owner.managedFeeds only when absent, indexes it by converttoxhash(instance), then calls SetupDynamicContainer(feed). No rollback, duplicate-registration guard or cleanup is present; InitFeedItems and dynamic-container bodies are separate dependencies.
